title: Obstruct planar monochromatic actuator spaces
statement: For one two-dimensional Laplacian eigenvalue lambda>0, let U=(partial2 psi,-partial1 psi,0),-Delta_2D psi=lambda psi, independent of x3. Curl U=lambda psi e3 and (U.nabla)U=gradient[(|U|^2+lambda psi^2)/2], so the ENTIRE space is Euler-null after Leray projection and Delta U=-lambda U. Any force in it yields exact nonlinear ODE U_t=-nu lambda U+f. Antipodal H1-radius-M data force some endpoint>=M exp(-nu lambda tau)/sqrt(1+lambda). Explicit rational actuators e1 cos/sin(2pi x2),e2 cos/sin(2pi x1) have two independent wavevector directions and mixed helicities, yet fail arbitrary-epsilon universal control. This restricted-family obstruction is not a full finite-family impossibility.
